nom: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Hand Cream with Shea Butter for Dry Hands

avis.texte: This lotion has finally solved my problem of horrible skin fissures on my finger tips I get during winter weather. I have tried many other products besides drug store lotions with little success. These cracks are so painful and never seem to heal before I hit them or cause them to return quickly. This stuff is AMAZING. Whatever’s in it has worked quickly and helped my skin heal. It’s not overly thick, has a nice texture, unscented and absorbs easily. I wish I could buy a larger size, but I do appreciate that for a small tube it is very reasonably priced. La Roche-Posay is a reputable skin care line that delivers without a high price tag and gets results. I am more than satisfied!

This hand cream has been a lifesaver. I work with harsh chemicals and wash my hands constantly, which left my hands severely cracked, painfully dry, and even bleeding. I’ve tried so many products with little to no relief, but this one actually healed my hands. Within a few days, the cracks started closing and the pain was gone. It absorbs well, doesn’t feel greasy, and creates a protective barrier that lasts. There is no scent to it and the consistency is like a petroleum jelly. A little goes a long way & you definitely get what you pay for! My hands finally look and feel healthy again. If you have damaged, overworked hands, this is 100% worth it!

avis.titre: The Only Hand Cream I Keep Coming Back To
avis.texte: I’ve bought this hand cream several times now. I initially purchased three tubes, and after finishing them, I came back and bought another five. That’s probably the best recommendation I can give. It’s incredibly moisturising without feeling greasy or sticky, absorbs quickly, and leaves my hands feeling soft for hours. I have dry skin, and this has made a noticeable difference. I also love that it’s fragrance-free. If you’re sensitive to scents or simply prefer skincare without added fragrance, this is a fantastic choice. If you do like scented hand creams, you can always layer it with your favourite fragranced lotion or cream. For anyone with dry hands looking for an effective, fast-absorbing hand cream, I highly recommend this one.

This is an outstanding hand cream that is very soothing to my very dry, older skin. It's much less greasy than Aquaphor. It's very gentle on my occassional eczema outbreaks as well. My complaint is that the tube is very small and doesn't last long. When I can no longer squeeze the cream out, I cut off the end of the tube and scoop out the remaining cream into a small jar so that I can use all of it.
Expensive, but worth every penny, I have tried several hand creams, but this one is beyond good, not greasy, not sticky, absorbs fast, hydrates very well, just excellent. Will keep buying

I really like this hand cream and have yet to find another one that works quite as well. It provides quick relief when my hands are dry or starting to crack, and the moisturizing effect lasts much longer than most lotions I have tried. The texture is thick enough to feel protective, but it absorbs surprisingly well and does not leave my hands feeling greasy. That makes it practical to use during the day without feeling like I need to wash it off before touching anything. I also appreciate that it is fragrance-free. A small amount goes a long way, so the tube lasts longer than expected. Even so, it is expensive for the amount you receive. That is the only reason I am taking off one star. I have tried several cheaper alternatives, but none have provided the same combination of relief, lasting moisture, and non-greasy feel. I will continue buying it unless I find something that works just as well for less.

My new favorite hand cream. It actually absorbs into the skin vs others . I do have sensitive skin and this does well with my skin so I am very happy. Will not be using any other hand cream. I used to use another hand cream from a different skincare company and it didn’t absorb and it seemed like it just sat onto the skin. This one actually moisturizes your skin and I came here to write a review to tell you that this works !! I work in healthcare , clean my house, and cook so I have to wash my hands multiple times a day

i have red dry hands and have rx from dermatologist (which doesn't help)--this is one of the best hand creams I've used and I've tried them all--I wouldn't say my hands are "healed" but it helps! Feels good when you put it on and seems to last for hours--not oily
I like this hand cream. It is not greasy and is great for very dry hands.

Para mí perfecta. No engrasa,con una cantidad minima hay suficiente Y con uso diario buen resultado

avis.titre: Finally Found a Hand Cream That Actually Works
avis.texte: I’ve tried a lot of hand creams, but this one honestly surprised me. My hands get really dry and sometimes even crack, especially with frequent washing, and this cream made a noticeable difference within a couple of days. It absorbs pretty quickly and doesn’t leave that greasy feeling, which I really appreciate since I hate slippery hands. The texture is smooth and a little goes a long way, so the tube lasts longer than expected. I also like that it’s fragrance-free because my skin can be sensitive to strong scents. After using it regularly, my hands feel softer, more hydrated, and way less irritated. Overall, it does exactly what it promises. Definitely keeping this in my daily routine.

Best lotion I’ve ever used because I’ve used a lot. It’s creamy and not overly greasy and my skin feels so moisturized. My daughter got me on this brand and I love it. No need to reapply lotion throughout the day since my skin stay dry. Highly recommend if you’re tired of trying other products that doesn’t give you the moisture that you need.
This cream is ideal for my hands, it keeps them super hydrated.
Love how moisture it is. It last a lot longer than any other brand. It feels like butter but better
Muy buen producto . Deja las manos súper hidratadas al instante de ponerte la crema. Devuelve el brillo y no es pegajosa y se sienten súper suave. Recomendado .

I absolutely love this hand cream! I am not sure how long it has been around but I sure could have used it in the past winter years when the cold dries out my hands. It keeps them moisturized and healthy looking without a greasy lasting affect. Definitely has became a staple item in my purse!

Have you ever had a tattoo, and no matter how loving you treat it, it still wants to develop a thick scab and heal poorly? It pulls ink? Buy this stuff. It’s glycerin based and moisturizes deep below the scab. You only need a tiny amount! But this has been wonderful on those tough spots - the scab eventually turns back to peeling and heals normally. It’s MAGICAL. I use the Cicaplast B5 when the tattoo is fresh, and I follow up when it starts to peel with the La Roche lotion. I also use the La Roche gentle face wash for dry skin. It started out as buying this stuff for skin care but I got curious as my sleeve was being done and it’s been the ultimate game changer. Ditch the Aquaphor people - it’s awful. Team La Roche! The picture is of the inner elbow that started to scab really thick, and healed without any ink pulling.

avis.titre: protection and moisturising for long time .
avis.texte: I've been using Cicaplast Hands by La Roche-Posay and I'm genuinely impressed. The texture is rich but absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue, which is a big plus. It immediately soothes dry, irritated skin and leaves my hands feeling protected and moisturized for hours, even after washing. What I especially love is that it's gentle enough to use on my child's hands too. His skin tends to get dry and sensitive, especially in colder weather, and this cream has really helped without causing any irritation. It's fragrance-free, effective, and perfect for the whole family.

Después de lavar trastes o realizar cualquier actividad que incluyera jabón o detergentes, mis manos sufrían, se agrietaban y resecaban. Lucían como manos de mujer adulta. Después de usar esta crema con tantos beneficios, después de cada actividad que realizo, mis manos lucen más jóvenes, hidratadas y suaves. Sin duda esta marca nunca decepcionada. Ya necesito una nueva.

avis.titre: Best hand cream for extremely dry hands
avis.texte: Frequent hand washing at my old job caused severe dryness, cuts and bleeding on the back my hands. This hand cream healed all my cuts when others made it worse. For dermatitis, consult a dermatologist only, not a general doctor or nurse.
I have eczema and this is one of the many products I use on my hands to help. Very nice and soaks in quick. Leaves hands soft. I use after washing my hands and it works well.

After reading a lot of reviews, I decided to purchase this hand cream. I was having trouble with dry skin on my hands and nothing I tried helped my hands. This cream feels like a barrier on your skin even after washing them. It doesn't have any fragrance to it which I love. After one use you will feel the difference and its not a greasy feeling. After continued use, my hands are not dry like they were and will continue to buy this lotion whenever I run out. Run don't walk for dry skin relief.

My hands get so chapped in the winter that my knuckles crack and bleed. This cream repaired them overnight!!!! You can still see the little lines from the cracks but no bleeding and cracks are healed. AND… you can do laundry, dishes etc and it doesn’t wash off. It’s the only cream I’ve tried that can do that. I will be using this forever!

avis.titre: For the price is very small.
avis.texte: It's the third time I buy this lotion and this time it's smaller than the previous ones. I don't know what the problem is with the product but for the price it is very small and little product.
I'm a huge fan of creams, and I've tried a lot of them. I really like this one. It leaves my hands feeling very soft and moisturized. I'll buy it again.
I like to wash my hands 100 times a day. And that's make my hands so dry and wrinkly. This product give a good hydration on my skin ! No sticky feel .
Very soft and not greasy at all you get result after few days using it.

This is a perfect travel sized lotion. There’s no scent and it’s a very light almost gel/silicone like lotion. My hands were very cracked but this helped alleviate it. Very easy to apply and a little goes along way.
I love this product and have purchased it several times, however I think I received a used tube. I just opened this box and product and there is barely any in the tube.

I’ve been buying this for a few years now, and they changed the formula! It makes my hands feel dry and gritty when I put it on, like I’m wearing gloves of sand. They chose to change the aluminum powder to corn flour to manufacture it more cheaply, and boy does it show. The new formulation shouldn’t be sold under the photo of the old bottle, they are not even close to similar. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

avis.titre: No fragrance and nice and smooth
avis.texte: I 1tried this because I'm sensitive to artificial fragrance. The tube was smaller than I thought (small enough for a little purse) but the product has an excellent feel to it, so worth it in my book. Smooth and not greasy. Will be a repeat purchase.
This feels like Aquaphor, but smells slightly better. A friend swears by this and says it’s not greasy, so maybe I just got a bad tube.
I have always had problems with the skin of my hands, but this cream is very good. It helped me very quickly and now my skin is very soft.

This is a good product for ongoing maintenance to keep your hands moisturized, however, it is not good for hands that are already dried and cracked. Like so many other products it hurts/stings when your skin is dry. I had to wash my hands to take it off because they were so red.

The product arrived without a box or seal of any kind. When I opened it, there was already lotion coming out. In the past there has been a plastic film on the container I had to remove. I love this product but I'm hesitant to use it this time.
Se la compre a mi novio, y sus manos se sienten más suaves e hidratadas 👍🏻

I have dry, sensitive, eczema-prone skin, and love La Roche-Posay's other Cicaplast (and Toleriane and Lipkar) products, so I figured I would at least like this hand cream... ...CREAM?! Turns out it's an OINTMENT, like Aquaphor: greasy-Vaseline'y.

This product was marketed as alcohol free. However it is not alcohol free. It made my hands worse. I used it two nights before bed. I woke up both mornings with my hands even drier. It does not stay on your hands either, after washing your hands, as it advertised. Avoid this product.

avis.titre: Did I get a used product?
avis.texte: Product was NOT sealed and was actually packed in 2 boxes? Pretty concerning for me coming from the brand itself…
The hand cream came in a messed up box and clearly has been used. Gross.
I have bought this several times. It is great to use before bed and around cuticles

avis.titre: Works quickly and lasts through handwashings.
avis.texte: This hand cream has a consistency that is similar to petroleum jelly, but is much lighter and easier to spread. I like that this is fragrance free and it starts to work immediately at soothing my dry hands. This coats my hands and keeps them feeling comfortable, soft, and smooth. This absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy mess on my hands. This stays on and protects my hands even through several handwashings.

I am an essential worker and this hand lotion really helps my rough hands. It leaves them feeling refreshed and soft. After applying, you can instantly tell the difference in how your hands feel. The ingredients are premium and I’d definitely recommend for anyone with rough, tough or dry hands.

1. Odor Free. 2. Immediately soothed my dry hands. 3. The product is not greasy, and leaves a soft smooth sensation on my hands. 4. This will be great in the winter time when my hands get very dry and chapped.

avis.titre: Wonderfully moisturizing; absorbs almost instantly; hands are silky afterward
avis.texte: This cream is wonderful. It absorbs almost instantly and my hands are silky afterward. I also had my boyfriend try this and he also thinks this hand lotion is fantastic. It comes out as a gel--more like petroleum jelly than a cream. I have no idea as to the cost of this tiny 1.69 fluid ounce tube. I would hope that it will not be more than $8 but I suspect they will price between $12-15 which would make this very expensive.

I have what I think is eczema on my hand that gets worse when I use certain cleaners or hot water, and I had tried several other products without much luck. This is the first thing that has made a difference. I have been putting it on 2-3 times a day when my hands start to look dry (usually after washing them or washing dishes). My skin doesn't itch or hurt as badly, and it doesn't look dry. It's not 100% better, but I looked after a few days and was surprised that it seems to be healing. Picture on the left is before I bought this, and the right is after 9 days. I haven't really changed anything else I am doing in terms of soaps or cleaners I use.

avis.titre: Stop wasting money looking elsewhere-this is it!
avis.texte: THIS is the one for those who have used everything on their dry, cracked hands! In less than 24 hours, my hands are almost healed after years of trying everything on the market. Truly almost everything. From my doctor/dermatologist to my local spa recommendations, nothing worked long term. I hope my review helps someone else suffering and the ridiculous search for help. I am thrilled to share this works!

I suffer from super dry and cracked hands. I work with cardboard a lot, and it sucks all the oils out of my hands, making them so dry. This lotion has helped me maintain them hydrated. Will buy again! My hands have never felt so soft. It has helped heal the cracks and repair my sking. Will require constant use to take effect.
Beats cream ever, works great on my skin, it’s very hydrating

avis.titre: The only thing that prevents cracked and bleeding skin
avis.texte: This picture was taken in October. Imagine what my hands would look like in January! I live in Wisconsin and our winters can get pretty brutal. In the past, my knuckles would turn black (my doctor said it was dirt getting into the cracks and under the skin, and no amount of scrubbing would help), and my fingertips would crack and bleed. Since they're my fingertips and I obviously use them constantly, I basically had cracked and bleeding fingertips from November to March every year. I've even slathered bag balm or vaseline jelly on my hands and slept with socks over them. Nothing helped until this. Thank you, Cicaplast! P.S. When I can't squeeze any more out, I cut off the top of the tube to make sure I'm getting all of it!

I use this cream on a regular basis. It has a rich but non-greasy texture — absorbs beautifully and leaves my hands feeling velvety smooth. For me, it’s the perfect option when I need to quickly restore my skin and keep my hands in great condition.

avis.titre: Buy this, you will be happy you did.
avis.texte: This is worth the money. Everyone says they are the best but I bought 7 lotions to test them and this one was the best. It leaves a soft surface not greasy, trust me there are ones that are reviewed saying they are not greasy and the ingredients are petroleum jelly! This one is truly not greasy and is long lasting. If you are on the fence, get this. You will be happy you did. I’m buying more.
